findings.fix: Add `IsStarProjection.exists_isPartialIsometry_of_unitization_unitary_conj {B} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] (hp : IsStarProjection p) (u : unitary (Unitization ℂ B)) (h : u * p * star u = q) : ∃ v : B, IsPartialIsometry v ∧ star v * v = p ∧ v * star v = q` in Perturbation.lean. Derive `exists_isPartialIsometry_of_norm_sub_lt_one`, `exists_isPartialIsometry_of_path`, and the matrix lemma from it.
findings.issue: `MurrayVonNeumannEquiv.of_unitization_unitary_conj` is the `B = CStarMatrix n n A` case of a general fact: a unitary of `Unitization ℂ B` conjugating star projection `p` to `q` yields `v : B` with `IsPartialIsometry v ∧ star v * v = p ∧ v * star v = q`. The same four-line proof is repeated at Perturbation.lean:542-545 and 559-562.

findings.evidence: Block.lean `instIsProperStar` installs `CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder` locally. Mathlib CStarMatrix.lean needs `PartialOrder`/`StarOrderedRing` only for the norm (line 555 onward), and the norm is not used here.
findings.fix: Drop `[PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]` from `of_unitization_unitary_conj`, or remove the lemma once the general version above exists.
findings.issue: `[PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]` are unused. The statement involves only `unitary (Unitization ℂ (CStarMatrix n n A))`, which needs no norm, and the proof uses `murrayVonNeumannEquiv_iff_exists_isPartialIsometry`, which only needs `IsProperStar`, supplied by `instIsProperStar` from `NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A` alone.

summary: The non-unital transfer from a unitization unitary to a partial isometry is proved three times, with one copy stated only for matrices. That matrix-only copy also takes order instances it never uses.
